- **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — formats bytes as human-readable string with one decimal (B, KB, MB, GB)
- **loadSettings(filePath)** in src/settings.js — reads JSON synchronously, applies defaults (theme: "dark", autosave: true), and throws AppError on missing files or malformed JSON
